title.suggested: Leon Schuler Obituary Recalls Allen and Mace Set-To

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported the death in Strasburg of St. Louis saloon-keeper Leon Schuler, recalling that he fenced at the Theatre Comique on a night when Jem Mace and Tom Allen sparred with gloves.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republican: St. Louis, Thursday Morning, December 7, 1882, page 3

facts.fact: Allen and Jem Mace had a set-to with gloves at the Theatre Comique, St. Louis

notes: The item is an obituary of Leon Schuler; Allen is mentioned once. Date of the Mace exhibition not given.
